capabilities: Validate model output against schemas before writing
Snapshot notes for one-click undo of a run
Install five example crews and a runs dashboard
Write run logs and schedule interval runs
disambiguation: Not a free-form autonomous agent loop; the orchestrator controls flow and writes while the model only produces schema-validated content.
extras: Desktop only. Live token streaming needs CORS enabled on the LLM server; otherwise the plugin falls back to non-streaming. Crews allowing note.create, note.append or note.move must set review: false, since the writing preview is not built yet. Optional call recording copies note text into the vault. Earlier versions required a git repo; no longer as of 0.2.0.
problem: Local models are unreliable executors, so letting an agent write to notes directly risks invented paths, uncontrolled flow and unrecoverable edits.
